data.name: Dark Ride
data.detailed_description:
Dark Ride is a virtual reality theme park designed for people who love cozy, atmospheric experiences. Step through the gates and wander at your own pace into attractions inspired by the classic dark rides found in theme parks—where every corner tells a story through handcrafted environments, lighting, sound, and delightful surprises.

Unlike traditional games, Dark Ride isn't about winning or rushing. It's about exploring magical spaces, uncovering charming details, and experiencing the quiet joy of being completely immersed in another world. Built natively for VR, each attraction invites you to slow down, look around, and become part of the story.

Whether you're searching for hidden secrets, enjoying whimsical scenery, or simply soaking in the atmosphere, Dark Ride offers a relaxing escape filled with wonder, nostalgia, and curiosity.

A Theme Park Built with Love

Dark Ride is the culmination of a world Paleozoic has been building in public over several years.

The journey began with Dark Ride: The Feline Fix, a cozy scavenger hunt set inside a magical potion shop, followed by Dark Ride: Sweet Dreams, a gentle theme park attraction released in Early Access to explore what a true VR dark ride could become.

Each was a self-contained attraction within the same growing park, experimenting with new ways to tell stories in virtual reality. Dark Ride brings them together into a living theme park filled with handcrafted experiences—expanding on everything players loved while opening the gates to entirely new adventures.

Whether you have ten minutes to unwind or an evening to lose yourself in enchanting worlds, Dark Ride is a place you'll want to return to, again and again.

Features:

  • Vibe-driven design. No stress, no timers, no fail states — just a calm space to explore, experiment, and enjoy at your own pace.

  • Made for everyone. Intuitive, relaxed interactions make this an inviting first VR experience for families and casual players alike.

  • A classic dark ride, reimagined in VR. Climb aboard and drift through handcrafted themed scenes brought to life with immersive sound, lighting, and special effects.

  • Playful interactions. Poke, grab, and tinker with the world around you — the park is full of funny surprises that react to your curiosity.

  • Explore beyond the ride. Step off and wander the park freely — soak in the atmosphere and discover details hidden in every corner.

  • Follow the clues. Solve them to unlock new areas of the park and uncover what lies beyond.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (21H2+)
  • Processor: Intel i5-8600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • VR Support: Requires a VR headset (Valve Index, HTC Vive, Vive Pro, Oculus Rift, Windows Mixed Reality, and other OpenXR-compatible devices)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (21H2+)
  • Processor: Intel i5-8600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 5600 XT
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • VR Support: Requires a VR headset (Valve Index, HTC Vive, Vive Pro, Oculus Rift, Windows Mixed Reality, and other OpenXR-compatible devices)
